title: MEDDPICC Qualification Lab
summary: A qualification practice experience that asks learners to classify discovery evidence, score MEDDPICC categories, compare their judgment with an expert benchmark, and identify next discovery actions.

content.business_need: Create applied practice for evaluating the strength of sales qualification using a realistic but fictional opportunity.
content.audience: Sales learners practicing structured opportunity qualification.
learning_objectives: Classify discovery evidence by MEDDPICC category.
Judge how strongly each category is qualified.
Compare learner judgment with an expert benchmark.
Identify qualification gaps and next discovery actions.
content.role: Instructional design, scenario design, interaction design, copywriting, and front-end development.
content.design_approach: Combine a reference explorer, fictional customer scenario, evidence-classification activity, category scorecard, expert comparison, and corrective feedback.
content.development_process: Built as a custom HTML, CSS, and JavaScript interaction using fictionalized sales information so the learning pattern can be demonstrated publicly.
outcomes: Demonstrates applied qualification practice rather than recall-only assessment.
Demonstrates structured scoring and expert calibration.
Provides a reusable pattern for future evidence-classification and qualification interactions.

source_material_notes: Public project uses fictional companies, products, customers, and opportunity data.
